divergence_note: Task description named seven passes; research report's own table listed nine (omitting 'Stale .backup files', SKILL.md Step 5). Enumeration here confirms the real, authoritative count is TEN distinct passes/cleanup targets. The two additional beyond the description's seven are the directory-cleanup operation (SKILL.md Steps 6-7 / claude-cleanup.sh, already covered by the SKILL's own 'two operations' framing but omitted from the description's per-pass list) and 'Stale .backup files' (SKILL.md Step 5), which is missing from both the task description and the research report's table.
